headline: Executive order lets the U.S. freeze property of, and bar entry to, certain people found to be contributing to the situation in Syria.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order allows the U.S. government to block, or freeze, property and assets in U.S. control that belong to certain people connected to the situation in Syria. It also suspends entry into the United States for those people. The title does not say exactly who is covered or how they are chosen.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups the U.S. government finds are contributing to the situation in Syria
who_it_affects.how: Their property under U.S. control can be frozen, and they can be barred from entering the United States.
They would generally be expected to stop dealing with the property of people named under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 14, 2019; the title does not state a separate start date.
